rationale: The assistant correctly diagnosed a failed grill element, stressed isolation at the cooker switch and MCB, advised checking terminals for scorching, and said to match the part by model and variant. Weaknesses: it told the customer they did not need to send the serial and never clearly said not to use the grill, and escalation for scorched wiring was soft. It also gave a few generic details such as 20-60 Ω and a 3-terminal layout, which are unverified for this model.
